title: Beam-line preprocessing and Timoshenko frame response

independentValidation.method: live numerical and serialized comparison with the pinned JavaScript source plus closed-form beam response
parityFixtures: node insertion at supports, point loads, uniform-load bounds, and requested subdivisions
simply supported beam under a generated midspan point-load node
partial uniform load split across covered elements
assigned Timoshenko GA and shear-correction factor
material- and section-derived Timoshenko shear rigidity

parityDifferences: No numerical, serialized DTO, unit-conversion, or tested error-behavior difference is known for this slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Usable solver-neutral preprocessing of a straight horizontal beam line into a 2D frame model, with nodes at supports and load discontinuities, point and uniform partial-span loads, springs, and explicit discretization. The closed-form Timoshenko element provides linear bending and shear deformation without shear locking. The preprocessor does not support trapezoidal loads. This slice does not yet provide the higher-level SingleBeamAnalysis load-case, combination, station, result-envelope, or section-provider pipeline and is not an RC verification application.
